name: Mercure Jakarta Gatot Subroto
short_description: A 403-room, 30-storey business hotel on the Gatot Subroto corridor in Kuningan Barat, South Jakarta, with Green Key sustainability certification and a 17th-floor pool bar.
ai_summary: Mercure Jakarta Gatot Subroto is a 403-room, 30-storey hotel on Jalan Gatot Subroto in Kuningan Barat, South Jakarta's golden-triangle business district, with direct access to the inner ring road and about 35 minutes from Soekarno-Hatta International Airport. The property is Green Key-certified for sustainability and includes a rooftop pool bar on the 17th floor, an executive lounge (Borobudur Lounge), 16 meeting rooms, a fitness centre, and spa. Dining spans Flora (international and local cuisine), Grand Cafe, Wayang Cafe, and Whiterock Terrace. Guest reviews consistently praise cleanliness, comfortable beds, and attentive staff, with some noting mixed views on whether room quality fully matches a four-star rating.

faqs.question: Is Mercure Jakarta Gatot Subroto good for business travellers?
faqs.answer: Yes -- it sits directly on the Gatot Subroto corridor in South Jakarta's golden-triangle business district, with direct inner ring road access, 16 meeting rooms, an executive lounge, and a location about 10 minutes from the Whoosh high-speed rail station at Halim.

faqs.question: Does Mercure Jakarta Gatot Subroto have a pool?
faqs.answer: Yes -- the hotel has a rooftop pool bar on the 17th floor with views over the surrounding urban skyline, alongside a fitness centre and spa. It's one of several recreational facilities at this 403-room, 30-storey property on the Gatot Subroto business corridor.
